lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 經理，三點來面試的那位先生已經到了，在門口等。
lines.simplified: 经理，三点来面试的那位先生已经到了，在门口等。
lines.pinyin: Jīnglǐ, sān diǎn lái miànshì de nà wèi xiānshēng yǐjīng dào le, zài ménkǒu děng.
lines.english: Manager, the man coming for the three o'clock interview is already here, waiting at the door.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這麼早？現在才兩點半。
lines.simplified: 这么早？现在才两点半。
lines.pinyin: Zhème zǎo? Xiànzài cái liǎng diǎn bàn.
lines.english: So early? It's only half past two.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 他說他對這裡的路不熟，怕找不到，所以早一點出門。
lines.simplified: 他说他对这里的路不熟，怕找不到，所以早一点出门。
lines.pinyin: Tā shuō tā duì zhèlǐ de lù bù shú, pà zhǎo bú dào, suǒyǐ zǎo yìdiǎn chūmén.
lines.english: He says he doesn't know the roads round here and was afraid he wouldn't find us, so he left early.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我三點以前得先把這份報告看完。你先請他到會議室坐一下，幫他倒杯水。
lines.simplified: 我三点以前得先把这份报告看完。你先请他到会议室坐一下，帮他倒杯水。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ sān diǎn yǐqián děi xiān bǎ zhè fèn bàogào kàn wán. Nǐ xiān qǐng tā dào huìyìshì zuò yíxià, bāng tā dào bēi shuǐ.
lines.english: I have to finish reading this report before three. First ask him to sit in the meeting room for a while, and pour him a glass of water.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好，我這就去。
lines.simplified: 好，我这就去。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ zhè jiù qù.
lines.english: OK, I'll go right now.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的說「我這就去」以後，那位先生等一下大概會怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 男的说「我这就去」以后，那位先生等一下大概会怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shuō "wǒ zhè jiù qù" yǐhòu, nà wèi xiānshēng děng yíxià dàgài huì zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: After the man says "I'll go right now", what will probably happen to the visitor?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 馬上被帶去跟經理見面
choices.simplified: 马上被带去跟经理见面
choices.pinyin: Mǎshàng bèi dài qù gēn jīnglǐ jiànmiàn.
choices.english: He will be taken straight in to meet the manager.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先到別的地方走走，三點再來
choices.simplified: 先到别的地方走走，三点再来
choices.pinyin: Xiān dào bié de dìfāng zǒu zou, sān diǎn zài lái.
choices.english: He will go somewhere else and come back at three.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 在會議室坐著，等經理看完報告
choices.simplified: 在会议室坐着，等经理看完报告
choices.pinyin: Zài huìyìshì zuò zhe, děng jīnglǐ kàn wán bàogào.
choices.english: He will sit in the meeting room until the manager has read her report.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài ménkǒu yìzhí děng dào sān diǎn.
choices.english: He will wait at the door until three.

questions.why: 我這就去 answers her request just before it: he takes the visitor to the meeting room now, while she still has to finish the report before three. 這就 is about the man acting at once, not the meeting; nobody sends the visitor away, and the door is where he waits only until the man comes.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你不是說今天要把房間整理好嗎？已經下午四點了。
lines.simplified: 你不是说今天要把房间整理好吗？已经下午四点了。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì shuō jīntiān yào bǎ fángjiān zhěnglǐ hǎo ma? Yǐjīng xiàwǔ sì diǎn le.
lines.english: Didn't you say you'd tidy your room today? It's already four in the afternoon.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我在等同學把報告的資料傳給我，等一下再整理。
lines.simplified: 我在等同学把报告的资料传给我，等一下再整理。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zài děng tóngxué bǎ bàogào de zīliào chuán gěi wǒ, děng yíxià zài zhěnglǐ.
lines.english: I'm waiting for a classmate to send me the material for our report. I'll tidy up later.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 等資料跟整理房間有什麼關係？等的時候就可以先整理啊。你阿姨六點就到了。
lines.simplified: 等资料跟整理房间有什么关系？等的时候就可以先整理啊。你阿姨六点就到了。
lines.pinyin: Děng zīliào gēn zhěnglǐ fángjiān yǒu shénme guānxi? Děng de shíhòu jiù kěyǐ xiān zhěnglǐ a. Nǐ āyí liù diǎn jiù dào le.
lines.english: What's waiting for material got to do with tidying your room? You can tidy while you wait. Your aunt arrives at six.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 阿姨不是明天才來嗎？
lines.simplified: 阿姨不是明天才来吗？
lines.pinyin: Āyí bú shì míngtiān cái lái ma?
lines.english: Isn't Auntie only coming tomorrow?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 她改時間了，今天晚上就要睡你的房間。
lines.simplified: 她改时间了，今天晚上就要睡你的房间。
lines.pinyin: Tā gǎi shíjiān le, jīntiān wǎnshàng jiù yào shuì nǐ de fángjiān.
lines.english: She changed the time. She's sleeping in your room tonight.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好，好，我這就去整理。
lines.simplified: 好，好，我这就去整理。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, hǎo, wǒ zhè jiù qù zhěnglǐ.
lines.english: OK, OK, I'll go and tidy it right now.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的告訴男的阿姨改了時間，是希望男的怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 女的告诉男的阿姨改了时间，是希望男的怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de gàosu nán de āyí gǎi le shíjiān, shì xīwàng nán de zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: The woman tells the man his aunt has changed her plans. What does she want him to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先看完資料，六點再整理
choices.simplified: 先看完资料，六点再整理
choices.pinyin: Xiān kàn wán zīliào, liù diǎn zài zhěnglǐ.
choices.english: Read the material first and tidy up at six.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 現在就整理，不要等到資料傳來
choices.simplified: 现在就整理，不要等到资料传来
choices.pinyin: Xiànzài jiù zhěnglǐ, bú yào děng dào zīliào chuán lái.
choices.english: Tidy up now instead of waiting until the material arrives.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 明天阿姨來以前整理好
choices.simplified: 明天阿姨来以前整理好
choices.pinyin: Míngtiān āyí lái yǐqián zhěnglǐ hǎo.
choices.english: Have it tidy before his aunt comes tomorrow.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 請同學快一點把資料傳來
choices.simplified: 请同学快一点把资料传来
choices.pinyin: Qǐng tóngxué kuài yìdiǎn bǎ zīliào chuán lái.
choices.english: Ask his classmate to send the material sooner.

questions.why: She brings up the change (the aunt comes today and sleeps in his room) to make him tidy now instead of after the material comes, and his 我這就去整理 shows it worked. Six is when the aunt arrives, not a time to start, and tomorrow was the old plan.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說那家公司要你下星期一去上班？
lines.simplified: 听说那家公司要你下星期一去上班？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà jiā gōngsī yào nǐ xià xīngqíyī qù shàngbān?
lines.english: I hear that company wants you to start next Monday?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對，可是我還在想要不要去。
lines.simplified: 对，可是我还在想要不要去。
lines.pinyin: Duì, kěshì wǒ hái zài xiǎng yào bú yào qù.
lines.english: Yes, but I'm still thinking about whether to go.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 為什麼？薪水不是比現在多嗎？
lines.simplified: 为什么？薪水不是比现在多吗？
lines.pinyin: Wèishénme? Xīnshuǐ bú shì bǐ xiànzài duō ma?
lines.english: Why? Isn't the pay better than now?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 儘管薪水比較多，可是離我家太遠了，坐車要一個半小時。
lines.simplified: 尽管薪水比较多，可是离我家太远了，坐车要一个半小时。
lines.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn xīnshuǐ bǐjiào duō, kěshì lí wǒ jiā tài yuǎn le, zuò chē yào yí ge bàn xiǎoshí.
lines.english: Even though the pay is better, it's too far from home: an hour and a half to get there.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那就搬到公司附近啊。
lines.simplified: 那就搬到公司附近啊。
lines.pinyin: Nà jiù bān dào gōngsī fùjìn a.
lines.english: Then move near the company.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我跟我媽一起住，我搬走了，誰照顧她？
lines.simplified: 我跟我妈一起住，我搬走了，谁照顾她？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gēn wǒ mā yìqǐ zhù, wǒ bān zǒu le, shéi zhàogù tā?
lines.english: I live with my mom. If I move away, who will look after her?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那請你媽媽跟你一起搬過去。
lines.simplified: 那请你妈妈跟你一起搬过去。
lines.pinyin: Nà qǐng nǐ māma gēn nǐ yìqǐ bān guòqù.
lines.english: Then ask your mom to move there with you.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 她的朋友都在這裡，說什麼都不肯走。
lines.simplified: 她的朋友都在这里，说什么都不肯走。
lines.pinyin: Tā de péngyǒu dōu zài zhèlǐ, shuō shénme dōu bù kěn zǒu.
lines.english: All her friends are here. She won't leave, whatever I say.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的現在還不能決定，主要是因為什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的现在还不能决定，主要是因为什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de xiànzài hái bù néng juédìng, zhǔyào shì yīnwèi shénme?
prompt.english: What mainly keeps the man from deciding?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qù le jiù hěn nán zhàogù māma.
choices.english: Taking the job would make it hard to look after his mom.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Māma bú ràng tā bān chūqù zhù.
choices.english: His mom won't let him move out.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他不想離開這裡的朋友
choices.simplified: 他不想离开这里的朋友
choices.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎng líkāi zhèlǐ de péngyǒu.
choices.english: He doesn't want to leave his friends here.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 新公司下星期一就得上班
choices.simplified: 新公司下星期一就得上班
choices.pinyin: Xīn gōngsī xià xīngqíyī jiù děi shàngbān.
choices.english: The new job starts as soon as next Monday.

questions.why: 儘管 sets the better pay aside: the office is too far, moving away would leave his mother alone, and she won't move with him. It is the MOTHER who refuses to move (she never stops him), and the friends who keep her here are hers, not his.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你看起來好累，又加班了？
lines.simplified: 你看起来好累，又加班了？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kàn qǐlái hǎo lèi, yòu jiābān le?
lines.english: You look exhausted. Working late again?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對啊，最近工作特別多，主管每天都留我們到九點。
lines.simplified: 对啊，最近工作特别多，主管每天都留我们到九点。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, zuìjìn gōngzuò tèbié duō, zhǔguǎn měi tiān dōu liú wǒmen dào jiǔ diǎn.
lines.english: Yes, there has been a lot of work lately, and the supervisor keeps us until nine every day.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 每天到九點？你怎麼不跟主管說說看？
lines.simplified: 每天到九点？你怎么不跟主管说说看？
lines.pinyin: Měi tiān dào jiǔ diǎn? Nǐ zěnme bù gēn zhǔguǎn shuō shuo kàn?
lines.english: Until nine every day? Why don't you try talking to your supervisor?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 累是累，不過她常常教我怎麼跟客人溝通，我學到了很多。
lines.simplified: 累是累，不过她常常教我怎么跟客人沟通，我学到了很多。
lines.pinyin: Lèi shì lèi, búguò tā chángcháng jiāo wǒ zěnme gēn kèrén gōutōng, wǒ xué dào le hěn duō.
lines.english: It is tiring, but she often teaches me how to deal with customers, and I've learned a lot.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你上次不是說她很愛批評人嗎？
lines.simplified: 你上次不是说她很爱批评人吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shàng cì bú shì shuō tā hěn ài pīpíng rén ma?
lines.english: Didn't you say last time that she loves criticizing people?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 儘管她說話不太客氣，可是說的都有道理。
lines.simplified: 尽管她说话不太客气，可是说的都有道理。
lines.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā shuōhuà bú tài kèqi, kěshì shuō de dōu yǒu dàolǐ.
lines.english: Even though she isn't very polite when she talks, what she says always makes sense.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那也要注意身體啊。
lines.simplified: 那也要注意身体啊。
lines.pinyin: Nà yě yào zhùyì shēntǐ a.
lines.english: You still need to look after yourself.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我知道，下個月這些工作做完就好了。
lines.simplified: 我知道，下个月这些工作做完就好了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào, xià ge yuè zhèxiē gōngzuò zuò wán jiù hǎo le.
lines.english: I know. Once this work is done next month, it'll be fine.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的對他的主管有什麼看法？
prompt.simplified: 男的对他的主管有什么看法？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de duì tā de zhǔguǎn yǒu shénme kànfǎ?
prompt.english: What does the man think of his supervisor?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 很會教人，可是不顧大家的身體
choices.simplified: 很会教人，可是不顾大家的身体
choices.pinyin: Hěn huì jiāo rén, kěshì bú gù dàjiā de shēntǐ.
choices.english: She teaches well but doesn't care about people's health.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 愛批評人，所以他不敢跟她說
choices.simplified: 爱批评人，所以他不敢跟她说
choices.pinyin: Ài pīpíng rén, suǒyǐ tā bù gǎn gēn tā shuō.
choices.english: She loves to criticize, so he dare not speak to her.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 給的工作太多，可是下個月會少一點
choices.simplified: 给的工作太多，可是下个月会少一点
choices.pinyin: Gěi de gōngzuò tài duō, kěshì xià ge yuè huì shǎo yìdiǎn.
choices.english: She gives too much work, but will give less next month.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 說話不好聽，可是說的都對
choices.simplified: 说话不好听，可是说的都对
choices.pinyin: Shuōhuà bù hǎotīng, kěshì shuō de dōu duì.
choices.english: She speaks harshly, but she is right.

questions.why: Asked about her criticism, he says 儘管她說話不太客氣，可是說的都有道理: blunt but right. Worrying about his health is the woman's point, not a complaint he makes; he gives a reason for not complaining rather than fear; and next month the TASKS end, nobody says she will give fewer.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳不是跟網友約好今天見面嗎？怎麼這麼早就回來了？
lines.simplified: 你不是跟网友约好今天见面吗？怎么这么早就回来了？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì gēn wǎngyǒu yuē hǎo jīntiān jiànmiàn ma? Zěnme zhème zǎo jiù huílái le?
lines.english: Weren't you meeting your online friend today? Why are you back so early?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我們在網路上聊了三個月，他說他是大學生，今年二十歲。
lines.simplified: 我们在网路上聊了三个月，他说他是大学生，今年二十岁。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen zài wǎnglù shàng liáo le sān ge yuè, tā shuō tā shì dàxuéshēng, jīnnián èrshí suì.
lines.english: We chatted online for three months. He said he was a university student, twenty years old.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那今天見到他了嗎？
lines.simplified: 那今天见到他了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nà jīntiān jiàn dào tā le ma?
lines.english: So did you meet him today?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 來的卻是一位四十多歲的先生，說他是那個大學生的哥哥，要先來看看我。
lines.simplified: 来的却是一位四十多岁的先生，说他是那个大学生的哥哥，要先来看看我。
lines.pinyin: Lái de què shì yí wèi sìshí duō suì de xiānshēng, shuō tā shì nàge dàxuéshēng de gēge, yào xiān lái kàn kan wǒ.
lines.english: But the one who came was a man in his forties. He said he was the student's older brother and wanted to see me first.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這樣子太奇怪了。
lines.simplified: 这样子太奇怪了。
lines.pinyin: Zhè yàngzi tài qíguài le.
lines.english: That's very strange.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對啊，我覺得不太對，喝了一杯咖啡就走了。
lines.simplified: 对啊，我觉得不太对，喝了一杯咖啡就走了。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, wǒ juéde bú tài duì, hē le yì bēi kāfēi jiù zǒu le.
lines.english: Right. Something felt wrong, so I left after one coffee.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼很快就離開了？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么很快就离开了？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme hěn kuài jiù líkāi le?
prompt.english: Why did the woman leave so soon?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 網友的哥哥請她先回去
choices.simplified: 网友的哥哥请她先回去
choices.pinyin: Wǎngyǒu de gēge qǐng tā xiān huíqù.
choices.english: The friend's brother asked her to go home.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Wǎngyǒu jīntiān méi kòng lái jiàn tā.
choices.english: Her online friend had no time to meet today.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nà wèi xiānshēng duì tā hěn lěngdàn.
choices.english: The man was cold towards her.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她覺得對方可能在騙她
choices.simplified: 她觉得对方可能在骗她
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde duìfāng kěnéng zài piàn tā.
choices.english: She felt the other person might be lying to her.

questions.why: 卻 marks the surprise: she expected a 20-year-old student, but a man in his forties came with a strange story, and 我覺得不太對 says she suspected a lie. Whether or not the student came, that is not why she left, and nobody asked her to go; the man was not said to be cold.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你的腳怎麼了？走路怎麼怪怪的？
lines.simplified: 你的脚怎么了？走路怎么怪怪的？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ de jiǎo zěnme le? Zǒulù zěnme guàiguài de?
lines.english: What's wrong with your foot? Why are you walking so oddly?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 上星期打籃球受傷了。本來以為沒什麼，直到昨天晚上痛得睡不著，才去看醫生。
lines.simplified: 上星期打篮球受伤了。本来以为没什么，直到昨天晚上痛得睡不着，才去看医生。
lines.pinyin: Shàng xīngqí dǎ lánqiú shòushāng le. Běnlái yǐwéi méi shénme, zhídào zuótiān wǎnshàng tòng de shuì bù zháo, cái qù kàn yīshēng.
lines.english: I hurt it playing basketball last week. I thought it was nothing, until last night it hurt so much I couldn't sleep, and only then did I see a doctor.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 醫生怎麼說？
lines.simplified: 医生怎么说？
lines.pinyin: Yīshēng zěnme shuō?
lines.english: What did the doctor say?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 他說不嚴重，可是這兩個星期都不能打球。假如兩個星期以後還會痛，就得再去檢查。
lines.simplified: 他说不严重，可是这两个星期都不能打球。假如两个星期以后还会痛，就得再去检查。
lines.pinyin: Tā shuō bù yánzhòng, kěshì zhè liǎng ge xīngqí dōu bù néng dǎ qiú. Jiǎrú liǎng ge xīngqí yǐhòu hái huì tòng, jiù děi zài qù jiǎnchá.
lines.english: He said it isn't serious, but no ball games for two weeks. If it still hurts after two weeks, I have to go back for a check.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那你這個星期六不是要代表系上打球嗎？
lines.simplified: 那你这个星期六不是要代表系上打球吗？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ zhège xīngqíliù bú shì yào dàibiǎo xì shàng dǎ qiú ma?
lines.english: But aren't you playing for the department this Saturday?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 只好請別人代替我了。
lines.simplified: 只好请别人代替我了。
lines.pinyin: Zhǐhǎo qǐng biérén dàitì wǒ le.
lines.english: I'll have to ask someone to take my place.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 兩個星期以後，要是男的腳已經不痛了，會怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 两个星期以后，要是男的脚已经不痛了，会怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Liǎng ge xīngqí yǐhòu, yàoshì nán de jiǎo yǐjīng bú tòng le, huì zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: If the man's foot no longer hurts after two weeks, what then?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 得再檢查一次才能打球
choices.simplified: 得再检查一次才能打球
choices.pinyin: Děi zài jiǎnchá yí cì cái néng dǎ qiú.
choices.english: He needs one more check before playing.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Kěyǐ dǎ qiú, búbì zài jiǎnchá.
choices.english: He can play again, with no second check.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hái děi zài xiūxí liǎng ge xīngqí.
choices.english: He must rest for two more weeks.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Háishì děi qǐng biérén dàitì tā.
choices.english: He still has to ask someone to replace him.

questions.why: Two lines combine: no ball games for these two weeks, and a second check only 假如 it still hurts after them. No pain means no check and he may play; asking someone to replace him was for this Saturday, inside the two weeks.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你好，請坐。你想來我們店裡打工，以前做過這樣的工作嗎？
lines.simplified: 你好，请坐。你想来我们店里打工，以前做过这样的工作吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, qǐng zuò. Nǐ xiǎng lái wǒmen diàn lǐ dǎgōng, yǐqián zuò guo zhèyàng de gōngzuò ma?
lines.english: Hello, have a seat. You want a part-time job at our café. Have you done this kind of work before?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 沒有。不過在煮咖啡方面，我有一些經驗。我在學校的咖啡社學了一年，也常煮給同學喝。
lines.simplified: 没有。不过在煮咖啡方面，我有一些经验。我在学校的咖啡社学了一年，也常煮给同学喝。
lines.pinyin: Méiyǒu. Búguò zài zhǔ kāfēi fāngmiàn, wǒ yǒu yìxiē jīngyàn. Wǒ zài xuéxiào de kāfēi shè xué le yì nián, yě cháng zhǔ gěi tóngxué hē.
lines.english: No. But when it comes to making coffee, I do have some experience. I learned for a year in the school coffee club, and I often make it for classmates.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我們店週末客人特別多，往往忙不過來。你週末能來嗎？
lines.simplified: 我们店周末客人特别多，往往忙不过来。你周末能来吗？
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen diàn zhōumò kèrén tèbié duō, wǎngwǎng máng bú guòlái. Nǐ zhōumò néng lái ma?
lines.english: We have lots of customers at weekends and often can't keep up. Can you come at weekends?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 星期六可以，星期天我得去補習班上英文課。
lines.simplified: 星期六可以，星期天我得去补习班上英文课。
lines.pinyin: Xīngqíliù kěyǐ, xīngqítiān wǒ děi qù bǔxíbān shàng Yīngwén kè.
lines.english: Saturday is fine. On Sunday I have an English class at a cram school.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這樣恐怕不太合適。我們最需要人的就是星期天。
lines.simplified: 这样恐怕不太合适。我们最需要人的就是星期天。
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng kǒngpà bú tài héshì. Wǒmen zuì xūyào rén de jiù shì xīngqítiān.
lines.english: Then I'm afraid it won't really work. Sunday is when we need people most.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 補習班的課我可以改到星期三晚上。不論星期六還是星期天，我都能來。
lines.simplified: 补习班的课我可以改到星期三晚上。不论星期六还是星期天，我都能来。
lines.pinyin: Bǔxíbān de kè wǒ kěyǐ gǎi dào xīngqísān wǎnshàng. Búlùn xīngqíliù háishì xīngqítiān, wǒ dōu néng lái.
lines.english: I can move the class to Wednesday evening. Saturday or Sunday, I can come either way.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好，那你這個星期六先來試試看吧。
lines.simplified: 好，那你这个星期六先来试试看吧。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, nà nǐ zhège xīngqíliù xiān lái shì shi kàn ba.
lines.english: All right, then come and give it a try this Saturday.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的提到學校的咖啡社，是想讓女的知道什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的提到学校的咖啡社，是想让女的知道什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de tí dào xuéxiào de kāfēi shè, shì xiǎng ràng nǚ de zhīdào shénme?
prompt.english: Why does the man mention the school coffee club?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他在學校的咖啡店做過一年
choices.simplified: 他在学校的咖啡店做过一年
choices.pinyin: Tā zài xuéxiào de kāfēi diàn zuò guo yì nián.
choices.english: He worked for a year at the school café.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他煮的咖啡比店裡的好喝
choices.simplified: 他煮的咖啡比店里的好喝
choices.pinyin: Tā zhǔ de kāfēi bǐ diàn lǐ de hǎohē.
choices.english: His coffee is better than the café's.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他沒做過這種工作，可是會煮咖啡
choices.simplified: 他没做过这种工作，可是会煮咖啡
choices.pinyin: Tā méi zuò guo zhè zhǒng gōngzuò, kěshì huì zhǔ kāfēi.
choices.english: He has never done this kind of work, but he can make coffee.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他還不太會煮，得再學一學
choices.simplified: 他还不太会煮，得再学一学
choices.pinyin: Tā hái bú tài huì zhǔ, děi zài xué yi xué.
choices.english: He can't really make it yet and needs to learn more.

questions.why: 沒有。不過在煮咖啡方面……: 不過 plus 在……方面 turns from the job he lacks to the one area where he does have experience, a year in the club. The year was spent learning in a club, not working; making it for classmates shows practice, not that it beats the café's; and he says he HAS experience.

focus.en: in terms of…; the speaker's purpose

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的說「這樣恐怕不太合適」，是因為什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的说「这样恐怕不太合适」，是因为什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shuō "zhèyàng kǒngpà bú tài héshì", shì yīnwèi shénme?
prompt.english: Why does the woman say "then I'm afraid it won't really work"?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 店裡最忙的那天他不能來
choices.simplified: 店里最忙的那天他不能来
choices.pinyin: Diàn lǐ zuì máng de nà tiān tā bù néng lái.
choices.english: He can't come on the café's busiest day.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā méi zài kāfēi diàn gōngzuò guo.
choices.english: He has never worked in a café.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xīngqíliù děi qù bǔxíbān.
choices.english: He has cram school on Saturdays.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 週末客人多，他忙不過來
choices.simplified: 周末客人多，他忙不过来
choices.pinyin: Zhōumò kèrén duō, tā máng bú guòlái.
choices.english: At weekends there are too many customers for him.

questions.why: Two turns combine: he has class on Sunday, and 我們最需要人的就是星期天. His class is on Sunday, not Saturday; no café experience did not stop the interview; and 忙不過來 is said of the café, not of him.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的最後讓男的來試試看，主要是因為什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的最后让男的来试试看，主要是因为什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de zuìhòu ràng nán de lái shì shi kàn, zhǔyào shì yīnwèi shénme?
prompt.english: Why does the woman finally let the man come for a try?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他煮的咖啡同學都喜歡
choices.simplified: 他煮的咖啡同学都喜欢
choices.pinyin: Tā zhǔ de kāfēi tóngxué dōu xǐhuān.
choices.english: His classmates all like his coffee.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xīngqísān wǎnshàng yě néng lái.
choices.english: He can also come on Wednesday evenings.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā shuō kěyǐ xiān lái shì shi kàn.
choices.english: He offered to come for a trial first.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他願意改課，週末都能來
choices.simplified: 他愿意改课，周末都能来
choices.pinyin: Tā yuànyì gǎi kè, zhōumò dōu néng lái.
choices.english: He is willing to move his class and can come both weekend days.

questions.why: Right after she says Sunday is the problem, he offers to move his class and adds 不論星期六還是星期天，我都能來, and only then she says 好. Wednesday evening is when he will be AT class, and the trial was her idea, not his offer.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我們小組新來的那位同事，妳覺得怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 我们小组新来的那位同事，你觉得怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen xiǎozǔ xīn lái de nà wèi tóngshì, nǐ juéde zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: What do you think of the new colleague on our team?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 他做事很細心，在電腦方面也懂得很多。上次我的電腦壞了，就是他修好的。
lines.simplified: 他做事很细心，在电脑方面也懂得很多。上次我的电脑坏了，就是他修好的。
lines.pinyin: Tā zuòshì hěn xìxīn, zài diànnǎo fāngmiàn yě dǒng de hěn duō. Shàng cì wǒ de diànnǎo huài le, jiù shì tā xiū hǎo de.
lines.english: He's careful in his work, and he knows a lot about computers. When my computer broke last time, he was the one who fixed it.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 可是他好像不太愛說話，開會的時候從來不說自己的看法。
lines.simplified: 可是他好像不太爱说话，开会的时候从来不说自己的看法。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì tā hǎoxiàng bú tài ài shuōhuà, kāihuì de shíhòu cónglái bù shuō zìjǐ de kànfǎ.
lines.english: But he doesn't seem to like talking. In meetings he never gives his own view.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 他才來兩個星期，跟大家還不熟嘛。
lines.simplified: 他才来两个星期，跟大家还不熟嘛。
lines.pinyin: Tā cái lái liǎng ge xīngqí, gēn dàjiā hái bù shú ma.
lines.english: He's only been here two weeks; he doesn't know everyone yet.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 經理下個月要我們小組去南部見客人，我本來在想要不要帶他去。
lines.simplified: 经理下个月要我们小组去南部见客人，我本来在想要不要带他去。
lines.pinyin: Jīnglǐ xià ge yuè yào wǒmen xiǎozǔ qù nánbù jiàn kèrén, wǒ běnlái zài xiǎng yào bú yào dài tā qù.
lines.english: Next month the manager wants our team to go south to see customers. I was wondering whether to take him.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 帶他去吧！不論是開車還是準備資料，他都能幫忙。多跟客人接觸，他也會比較敢說話。
lines.simplified: 带他去吧！不论是开车还是准备资料，他都能帮忙。多跟客人接触，他也会比较敢说话。
lines.pinyin: Dài tā qù ba! Búlùn shì kāichē háishì zhǔnbèi zīliào, tā dōu néng bāngmáng. Duō gēn kèrén jiēchù, tā yě huì bǐjiào gǎn shuōhuà.
lines.english: Take him! Driving or preparing documents, he can help either way. And meeting more customers will make him bolder about speaking up.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好，那我這就去跟經理說。
lines.simplified: 好，那我这就去跟经理说。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, nà wǒ zhè jiù qù gēn jīnglǐ shuō.
lines.english: OK, I'll go and tell the manager right now.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 照女的說的，下面哪一件事最適合請新同事幫忙？
prompt.simplified: 照女的说的，下面哪一件事最适合请新同事帮忙？
prompt.pinyin: Zhào nǚ de shuō de, xiàmiàn nǎ yí jiàn shì zuì shìhé qǐng xīn tóngshì bāngmáng?
prompt.english: Going by what the woman says, which job is it best to ask the new colleague to help with?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 跟客人說明產品的價錢
choices.simplified: 跟客人说明产品的价钱
choices.pinyin: Gēn kèrén shuōmíng chǎnpǐn de jiàqián.
choices.english: Explaining product prices to customers.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 看看電腦出了什麼問題
choices.simplified: 看看电脑出了什么问题
choices.pinyin: Kàn kan diànnǎo chū le shénme wèntí.
choices.english: Finding out what is wrong with a computer.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 在會議上說出小組的看法
choices.simplified: 在会议上说出小组的看法
choices.pinyin: Zài huìyì shàng shuō chū xiǎozǔ de kànfǎ.
choices.english: Giving the team's view in a meeting.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 安排小組去南部的行程
choices.simplified: 安排小组去南部的行程
choices.pinyin: Ānpái xiǎozǔ qù nánbù de xíngchéng.
choices.english: Planning the team's trip south.

questions.why: She says 在電腦方面也懂得很多 and backs it with the computer he fixed, so a computer problem is his field. Talking to customers and speaking up in meetings are exactly what he is not yet bold about, and the trip is the manager's plan; he only helps with driving and documents.

focus.en: in terms of…; applying what was said

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的說新同事開會不說話，女的怎麼看這件事？
prompt.simplified: 男的说新同事开会不说话，女的怎么看这件事？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shuō xīn tóngshì kāihuì bù shuōhuà, nǚ de zěnme kàn zhè jiàn shì?
prompt.english: The man says the new colleague is silent in meetings. How does the woman see this?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他只是還不習慣，不用擔心
choices.simplified: 他只是还不习惯，不用担心
choices.pinyin: Tā zhǐshì hái bù xíguàn, búyòng dānxīn.
choices.english: He just isn't used to things yet; no need to worry.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他個性就這樣，不用逼他
choices.simplified: 他个性就这样，不用逼他
choices.pinyin: Tā gèxìng jiù zhèyàng, búyòng bī tā.
choices.english: That's just his nature; don't push him.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他不夠認真，該跟他說說
choices.simplified: 他不够认真，该跟他说说
choices.pinyin: Tā bú gòu rènzhēn, gāi gēn tā shuō shuo.
choices.english: He isn't serious enough; someone should talk to him.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他電腦好，不說話也沒關係
choices.simplified: 他电脑好，不说话也没关系
choices.pinyin: Tā diànnǎo hǎo, bù shuōhuà yě méi guānxi.
choices.english: He's good with computers, so silence doesn't matter.

questions.why: 他才來兩個星期，跟大家還不熟嘛: newness, which will pass. She doesn't call it his nature (that is closer to the man's view), and she does want him to speak more, since she hopes the trip makes him 比較敢說話.

focus.zh: 才 + 時間；說話人的態度

prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de jiànyì dài xīn tóngshì qù nánbù, shì wèishénme?
prompt.english: Why does the woman suggest taking the new colleague south?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jīnglǐ yào xiǎozǔ de rén dōu qù.
choices.english: The manager wants everyone in the team to go.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他跟南部的客人比較熟
choices.simplified: 他跟南部的客人比较熟
choices.pinyin: Tā gēn nánbù de kèrén bǐjiào shú.
choices.english: He knows the southern customers better.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā néng bāngmáng, yě néng duō liànxí.
choices.english: He can be useful and also get practice.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā zìjǐ shuō xiǎng qù jiàn kèrén.
choices.english: He himself said he wants to meet customers.

questions.why: She gives two reasons: 不論是開車還是準備資料，他都能幫忙, and meeting customers will make him bolder. The man is still deciding whether to take him, so not everyone must go; he is the one who is 不熟; and the idea is hers, not his.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段留言，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段留言，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn liúyán, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a voicemail, then answer three questions.

passage.traditional: 我在一家電腦公司負責賣電腦。{1}我在學校學過很多跟電腦有關的知識，剛開始跟客人說話的時候，還是常常緊張得說不出話來。主管發現以後，沒有批評我，{2}每天下班後陪我練習。她告訴我，跟客人說話的時候要{3}一點，別只說自己的產品有多好，要先聽聽客人需要什麼，{4}買東西的是客人。她還說，雖然也有客人當天就買，但是第一次見面的客人{5}不會馬上決定，別太著急；{6}以後會不會買，就要看我們的服務了。
passage.simplified: 我在一家电脑公司负责卖电脑。{1}我在学校学过很多跟电脑有关的知识，刚开始跟客人说话的时候，还是常常紧张得说不出话来。主管发现以后，没有批评我，{2}每天下班后陪我练习。她告诉我，跟客人说话的时候要{3}一点，别只说自己的产品有多好，要先听听客人需要什么，{4}买东西的是客人。她还说，虽然也有客人当天就买，但是第一次见面的客人{5}不会马上决定，别太着急；{6}以后会不会买，就要看我们的服务了。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ zài yì jiā diànnǎo gōngsī fùzé mài diànnǎo. Jǐnguǎn wǒ zài xuéxiào xué guo hěn duō gēn diànnǎo yǒuguān de zhīshì, gāng kāishǐ gēn kèrén shuōhuà de shíhòu, háishì chángcháng jǐnzhāng de shuō bù chū huà lái. Zhǔguǎn fāxiàn yǐhòu, méiyǒu pīpíng wǒ, fǎn'ér měi tiān xiàbān hòu péi wǒ liànxí. Tā gàosu wǒ, gēn kèrén shuōhuà de shíhòu yào qiānxū yìdiǎn, bié zhǐ shuō zìjǐ de chǎnpǐn yǒu duō hǎo, yào xiān tīng ting kèrén xūyào shénme, bìjìng mǎi dōngxi de shì kèrén. Tā hái shuō, suīrán yě yǒu kèrén dāngtiān jiù mǎi, dànshì dì yī cì jiànmiàn de kèrén wǎngwǎng bú huì mǎshàng juédìng, bié tài zhāojí; zhìyú yǐhòu huì bú huì mǎi, jiù yào kàn wǒmen de fúwù le.
passage.english: My job at a computer company is selling computers. Even though I had learned a lot about computers at school, when I first started talking to customers I was still often too nervous to speak. When my supervisor noticed, she didn't criticize me; instead she practised with me every day after work. She told me to be a bit modest when talking to customers: don't just say how good our products are, first listen to what the customer needs, since after all it is the customer who buys. She also said that although some customers buy the same day, customers meeting us for the first time usually don't decide straight away, so don't be in a hurry; as for whether they buy later, that depends on our service.

passage.english: This year our team was in charge of setting up the venue for the company sports day. After several discussions, we finally had everything ready the day before. Unexpectedly, heavy rain started suddenly that morning, and we had no choice but to move everything indoors. Right after we moved in, the venue was chaotic: things were all over the floor and nobody could find what they needed. Time was tight, yet nobody lost their temper; we split up the jobs ourselves and helped each other. After the event the manager said our set-up wasn't the prettiest, but our teamwork was the best. Through this experience, we all learned how to solve problems together.

text.traditional:
我在一家旅行社負責面試新人，已經做了十年。這十年來，我發現來面試的年輕人往往很緊張，怕說錯話，所以每個問題都回答得很短。其實，我不太在意他們說得好不好聽，我想知道的是他們怎麼想、怎麼做。
去年有一位小姐來面試。她念的學校不是最好的，也沒有在旅行社工作過。我問她有沒有碰過什麼困難，她說大學的時候，她帶幾個外國朋友去環島，在東部碰到颱風，火車都停了。儘管那時候她也很著急，她還是冷靜地重新安排了行程，讓大家在山上的民宿多住了兩天，最後大家都玩得很開心。
聽完以後，我就決定錄取她。她上班以後，不論客人有什麼要求，她都會想辦法處理，現在是我們公司客人最喜歡的人。
所以，我常跟來面試的人說，別只想給我一個標準的答案。說說你真正碰過的事，讓我知道你在處理問題方面的能力，這比什麼都重要。
text.simplified:
我在一家旅行社负责面试新人，已经做了十年。这十年来，我发现来面试的年轻人往往很紧张，怕说错话，所以每个问题都回答得很短。其实，我不太在意他们说得好不好听，我想知道的是他们怎么想、怎么做。
去年有一位小姐来面试。她念的学校不是最好的，也没有在旅行社工作过。我问她有没有碰过什么困难，她说大学的时候，她带几个外国朋友去环岛，在东部碰到台风，火车都停了。尽管那时候她也很着急，她还是冷静地重新安排了行程，让大家在山上的民宿多住了两天，最后大家都玩得很开心。
听完以后，我就决定录取她。她上班以后，不论客人有什么要求，她都会想办法处理，现在是我们公司客人最喜欢的人。
所以，我常跟来面试的人说，别只想给我一个标准的答案。说说你真正碰过的事，让我知道你在处理问题方面的能力，这比什么都重要。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zài yì jiā lǚxíngshè fùzé miànshì xīnrén, yǐjīng zuò le shí nián. Zhè shí nián lái, wǒ fāxiàn lái miànshì de niánqīngrén wǎngwǎng hěn jǐnzhāng, pà shuō cuò huà, suǒyǐ měi ge wèntí dōu huídá de hěn duǎn. Qíshí, wǒ bú tài zàiyì tāmen shuō de hǎo bù hǎotīng, wǒ xiǎng zhīdào de shì tāmen zěnme xiǎng, zěnme zuò. Qùnián yǒu yí wèi xiǎojiě lái miànshì. Tā niàn de xuéxiào bú shì zuì hǎo de, yě méiyǒu zài lǚxíngshè gōngzuò guo. Wǒ wèn tā yǒu méiyǒu pèng guo shénme kùnnán, tā shuō dàxué de shíhòu, tā dài jǐ ge wàiguó péngyǒu qù huándǎo, zài dōngbù pèng dào táifēng, huǒchē dōu tíng le. Jǐnguǎn nà shíhòu tā yě hěn zhāojí, tā háishì lěngjìng de chóngxīn ānpái le xíngchéng, ràng dàjiā zài shān shàng de mínsù duō zhù le liǎng tiān, zuìhòu dàjiā dōu wán de hěn kāixīn. Tīng wán yǐhòu, wǒ jiù juédìng lùqǔ tā. Tā shàngbān yǐhòu, búlùn kèrén yǒu shénme yāoqiú, tā dōu huì xiǎng bànfǎ chǔlǐ, xiànzài shì wǒmen gōngsī kèrén zuì xǐhuān de rén. Suǒyǐ, wǒ cháng gēn lái miànshì de rén shuō, bié zhǐ xiǎng gěi wǒ yí ge biāozhǔn de dá'àn. Shuō shuo nǐ zhēnzhèng pèng guo de shì, ràng wǒ zhīdào nǐ zài chǔlǐ wèntí fāngmiàn de nénglì, zhè bǐ shénme dōu zhòngyào.
text.english:
I have been in charge of interviewing new staff at a travel agency for ten years. In that time I have found that young people who come for interviews are usually nervous and afraid of saying the wrong thing, so they answer every question briefly. In fact, I don't much care whether they speak nicely; what I want to know is how they think and act.
Last year a young woman came for an interview. The school she went to wasn't the best, and she had never worked at a travel agency. I asked whether she had ever faced a difficulty. She said that at university she took some foreign friends round the island, and in the east they ran into a typhoon and all the trains stopped. Even though she was worried too, she calmly rearranged the trip so everyone stayed two more days at a guesthouse in the mountains, and in the end they all had a great time.
After hearing that, I decided to hire her. Since she started, whatever customers ask for, she finds a way to handle it, and now she is the customers' favourite in our office.
So I often tell people who come for interviews: don't just try to give me a standard answer. Tell me what you have really been through, so I know what you can do when it comes to handling problems. That matters more than anything.

text.traditional:
我在臺灣一家公司上班兩年了。剛來的時候，有很多事讓我不習慣。在我的國家，下班時間到了，要是主管還沒走，大家往往不好意思先離開。可是在這家公司，六點一到，同事們就說再見回家了。我本來以為他們不夠認真，後來才發現，他們上班的時候做事很快，也很專心。
還有一件讓我驚訝的事，是開會的方式。有一次，經理問大家對新產品有什麼看法。我覺得自己是新人，應該謙虛一點，就什麼都沒說。會議結束以後，經理卻來找我，問我是不是對新產品有什麼不滿。我這才明白，在這家公司，開會時不說話不是謙虛，反而會讓別人誤會。
從那次以後，不論我的想法對不對，我都會在會議上說出來。儘管有時候說錯了，同事們也不會笑我，還會跟我一起討論。現在我覺得，在溝通方面，我比兩年前進步了很多。
text.simplified:
我在台湾一家公司上班两年了。刚来的时候，有很多事让我不习惯。在我的国家，下班时间到了，要是主管还没走，大家往往不好意思先离开。可是在这家公司，六点一到，同事们就说再见回家了。我本来以为他们不够认真，后来才发现，他们上班的时候做事很快，也很专心。
还有一件让我惊讶的事，是开会的方式。有一次，经理问大家对新产品有什么看法。我觉得自己是新人，应该谦虚一点，就什么都没说。会议结束以后，经理却来找我，问我是不是对新产品有什么不满。我这才明白，在这家公司，开会时不说话不是谦虚，反而会让别人误会。
从那次以后，不论我的想法对不对，我都会在会议上说出来。尽管有时候说错了，同事们也不会笑我，还会跟我一起讨论。现在我觉得，在沟通方面，我比两年前进步了很多。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zài Táiwān yì jiā gōngsī shàngbān liǎng nián le. Gāng lái de shíhòu, yǒu hěn duō shì ràng wǒ bù xíguàn. Zài wǒ de guójiā, xiàbān shíjiān dào le, yàoshì zhǔguǎn hái méi zǒu, dàjiā wǎngwǎng bù hǎoyìsi xiān líkāi. Kěshì zài zhè jiā gōngsī, liù diǎn yí dào, tóngshìmen jiù shuō zàijiàn huíjiā le. Wǒ běnlái yǐwéi tāmen bú gòu rènzhēn, hòulái cái fāxiàn, tāmen shàngbān de shíhòu zuòshì hěn kuài, yě hěn zhuānxīn. Hái yǒu yí jiàn ràng wǒ jīngyà de shì, shì kāihuì de fāngshì. Yǒu yí cì, jīnglǐ wèn dàjiā duì xīn chǎnpǐn yǒu shénme kànfǎ. Wǒ juéde zìjǐ shì xīnrén, yīnggāi qiānxū yìdiǎn, jiù shénme dōu méi shuō. Huìyì jiéshù yǐhòu, jīnglǐ què lái zhǎo wǒ, wèn wǒ shì bú shì duì xīn chǎnpǐn yǒu shénme bùmǎn. Wǒ zhè cái míngbái, zài zhè jiā gōngsī, kāihuì shí bù shuōhuà bú shì qiānxū, fǎn'ér huì ràng biérén wùhuì. Cóng nà cì yǐhòu, búlùn wǒ de xiǎngfǎ duì bú duì, wǒ dōu huì zài huìyì shàng shuō chūlái. Jǐnguǎn yǒu shíhòu shuō cuò le, tóngshìmen yě bú huì xiào wǒ, hái huì gēn wǒ yìqǐ tǎolùn. Xiànzài wǒ juéde, zài gōutōng fāngmiàn, wǒ bǐ liǎng nián qián jìnbù le hěn duō.
text.english:
I have worked for a company in Taiwan for two years. When I first came, many things felt strange. In my country, when it is time to go home but the supervisor hasn't left, people usually feel awkward about leaving first. But at this company, the moment it is six, colleagues say goodbye and go home. At first I thought they weren't serious enough about work; later I found they work fast and with focus during the day.
Another thing that surprised me was how meetings work. Once the manager asked everyone what they thought of a new product. I felt that as a newcomer I should be modest, so I said nothing. After the meeting, though, the manager came to ask whether I was unhappy about the new product. Only then did I understand that in this company, saying nothing in a meeting isn't modesty; instead it makes people misunderstand you.
Since then, whether my ideas are right or not, I say them in meetings. Even though I am sometimes wrong, my colleagues don't laugh at me; they discuss it with me. I now feel that when it comes to communicating, I have improved a lot in two years.

choices.pinyin: Xiǎng pīpíng tā tài guò qiānxū.

questions.why: Both stories are first impressions he corrected: leaving at six is not laziness, and silence in meetings is not modesty, and now 不論我的想法對不對，我都會……說出來. "Easier" is the first wrong idea he drops, modesty in meetings is what he unlearns, and the colleagues' help is only one detail.
